# Eve Runciman | Brickell Brokers

> Miami real estate guidance for buyers and property owners from Eve Runciman, a Florida-licensed attorney and real estate professional with over 20 years of experience in real estate, business transactions and law. Works with local, out-of-state and international clients.

Offers free property alerts for on-market and privately marketed homes, a free Sell vs. Rent Report for property owners, and a Private Off-Market Seller List.
Areas served: Coral Gables, Coconut Grove, Pinecrest, South Miami, Key Biscayne and Brickell.
Contact: 305-804-2262, eve@reaf.llc, WhatsApp, Miami, FL.

## Services
- [Buyer alerts](https://ai-workflow-labs.github.io/demo-sites/eve-runciman/buyers/): register criteria and receive matching alerts by email or WhatsApp
- [Sell vs. Rent Report](https://ai-workflow-labs.github.io/demo-sites/eve-runciman/sellers/): free comparison of selling and renting one Miami property
- [Private Off-Market Seller List](https://ai-workflow-labs.github.io/demo-sites/eve-runciman/sellers/private-list/): hear from qualified buyers without publicly listing
- [Featured properties](https://ai-workflow-labs.github.io/demo-sites/eve-runciman/properties/): search by neighborhood, type, bedrooms and price

## Guides
- [Should You Sell or Rent Your Miami Home?](https://ai-workflow-labs.github.io/demo-sites/eve-runciman/guides/sell-or-rent-miami-home/): what to compare, plus Florida homestead and capital gains rules
- [Buying Miami Property from Another State or Country](https://ai-workflow-labs.github.io/demo-sites/eve-runciman/guides/buying-miami-property-from-abroad/): eligibility, financing, insurance and closing from a distance
